Hi Alex — great to hear the signal, and congrats to the team on the tests. Short answer: yes, we can help. Two practical options we typically offer for these time-boxed POCs:

Option A — Credit voucher: Redwood can issue a one-time voucher (applies to hosted usage) that covers surges. Voucher would be usable during the current POC window. Works well if you want immediate headroom without changing the contract.

Option B — Short extension + discounted rate: 10 business days extension at a reduced rate card for that period (example: 20% off token rate for the extension window). Good if you want predictable runway for an integration window.

We can combine the two (smaller voucher + 4–7 day extension) if you prefer. A couple of operational notes: vouchers apply to hosted API capacity and don't reserve dedicated GPUs; if you need guaranteed concurrency/throughput we should scope a short Dedicated burst or capacity guard (that requires a brief provisioning lead time).

I've attached a one-pager with a sample MAP for POCs (Lumenix-POC-MAP-2027.pdf) and a sample term sheet. If you confirm which option you prefer I can loop in Sean (sales lead) and Monica (CS) to get approvals and lock timelines.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
